lessons.name: hot_cross_buns
lessons.title: Hot Cross Buns
lessons.instructions: Only three notes in the right hand: E, D and C with fingers 3, 2 and 1. The third bar has quick repeated notes — keep the finger close to the key.
tips: Count 'one and two and' in bar three.
The left hand holds long notes: press once and keep the key down for the whole bar.
